title: TrueRise intent contract (G32): sealed per-item acceptance ledger
description: The structured upgrade of run --goal: a goal sentence, acceptance items (each EXPLICITLY machine or human), non-goals, exclusions, and the SHA-256 seal over the canonical JSON of the bare contract. Any post-hoc edit is a different contract; a token that skips an item is not a confirmation.

acceptance_items.description: per-item finish line; every item carries id/text/kind (kind has no default)

sealed_hash.description: SHA-256 hex over the canonical JSON of the bare contract
